notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.0.2[/p][list][*][p]Fixed various bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Wormhole now returns you to half of your max stage reached.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.0.1[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the spawn rate issue with special (and chest) Aliens > If you'd like to see what these mobs look like, you can find them in the Captain's Log > Messages > Special Aliens. (Machiner Alien, Biomass Alien, Gold Alien, and Splicer Aliens). [/p][list][*][p]Please Note: The Gold Alien is a chest type mob and counts differently for the quests than the other three Special Aliens.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased cap on Geodes to 10k so you can hoard and spend them strategically if you wish.[/p][list][*][p]If you hit the cap before you unlock the Mines window, it will no longer show you the message.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect placement text on auto-tap tutorial \[It now says bottom left].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Biomass Vials being stretched slightly. \[These give you biomass / exp][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Daily \[and weekly] login rewards panel auto-closing. \[It gave you the rewards you just didn't get to see what it gave you!][/p][list][*][p]Note: Weeklies reset on Saturday evening (US time zones).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General Amrat in the Staff window's unlock and spend requirements have been lowered.[/p][list][*][p]She now unlocks reaching Stage 101 and having 25 Employee Badges spent in that wormhole run.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you unlock her the first time, you'll need to spend 25 Employee badges on subsequent runs for her to show. \[But no longer requires Stage 101][/p][/*][*][p]Note: She charges 50 Employee Badges for 2% Hp/Dmg permanent bonus that does not reset on a Wormhole.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
